name: studio-template
description: Static multi-page studio template. Rebrand via css/tokens.css and js/brand.js.

scripts.build:custom-css: npx postcss css/site.css css/products.css css/read-more.css --use cssnano --no-map --replace
scripts.build:js: npx terser js/site.js -o js/site.min.js --compress --mangle && npx terser js/services.js -o js/services.min.js --compress --mangle
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:custom-css && npm run build:js
